snippet.title: Rootknot - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Juggle your way through the demonic unknown in Rootknot, a fast-paced deck-building roguelite where dexterity and strategy go hand in hand.

Toss items into the air and draw loops around the ones you want to catch and activate. Build your deck with items that damage enemies, heal you or create other tactical effects, while facing demons with unique mechanics inspired by lesser-known folktales.

Gather crafting materials between runs to develop your base and unlock new features, dungeons, relics and items as you venture deeper into Rootknot's mysterious world.

Wishlist Rootknot now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4564690/Rootknot/

Coming to PC in Q3 2027.
